t: 克孜克斯主教尼丰被封为君士坦丁堡牧首.
te: Nephon, Bishop of Cyzicus, is consecrated as Patriarch of Constantinople.
dz: 克孜克斯主教尼丰被封为君士坦丁堡牧首.
de: Nephon, Bishop of Cyzicus, is consecrated as Patriarch of Constantinople.

dz: 铁波罗阴谋试图夺取威尼斯共和国的权力,在威尼斯血腥的街头冲突后被挫败. 平定了起义,将成立"十会".
de: The Tiepolo conspiracy, seeking to seize power in the Republic of Venice, is thwarted after bloody street clashes in Venice. The suppression of the revolt will lead to the creation of the Council of Ten.

dz: 罗得斯城向圣约翰骑士团的军队投降,完成了对罗得斯的征服. 骑士们在岛上建立了总部,并把自己更名为"罗兹骑士".
de: The city of Rhodes surrenders to the forces of the Knights of St. John, completing their conquest of Rhodes. The knights establish their headquarters on the island and rename themselves the Knights of Rhodes.
